plans.note: Limitation of liability / consequential damages waiver is customarily placed at the end of the indemnity article (sec-11-2, ToC entry sec-11); check Article 13 for any residual liability or disclaimer language. Confirm mutuality and whether a monetary cap exists at all in this collaboration structure.

Article 11 INDEMNITY should contain Harpoon's indemnity of AbbVie Indemnitees (defined term present) plus AbbVie's reciprocal indemnity of Harpoon Indemnitees; assess whether Harpoon covers third-party IP infringement from the Licensed Compound/Harpoon Patents and whether our indemnity is kept narrow.

Defined terms 'Competitor' and 'Segregate' signal a competing-program/exclusivity covenant restricting AbbVie; look in Article 5 grant/exclusivity provisions and the AbbVie covenants in sec-10.4, with Article 4 commercialization as a secondary location.

Exclusive licence/option architecture plus 'Segregate' definition suggests exclusivity or non-compete covenants on AbbVie in Article 5; also check Article 3 development diligence and sec-10.4 covenants for supply/sourcing restrictions. Note field-limited exclusivity granted to us is a benefit, not a deviation.

No MFN/best-terms concept appears in the defined terms or headings; scan Article 6 payment terms and Article 5 grant for any 'no less favourable terms' language before concluding absent. Any MFN running in our favour would not be flagged.
No non-solicit defined terms or headings; if present it would sit among the Article 13 miscellaneous covenants or alongside the Article 9 confidentiality restrictions.

Article 12 should carry AbbVie's termination at will/for convenience on notice plus Harpoon's termination rights; check whether Harpoon can terminate other than for our uncured material breach or insolvency, and whether any termination fee attaches to our exit.

Term is likely tied to the Royalty Term / Licensed Product life rather than an auto-renewing subscription term; verify sec-12.1 Term for any evergreen renewal or notice window before treating the rule as inapplicable/absent.

Governing law, dispute escalation to Senior Officers and venue/arbitration should be in Article 13 miscellaneous; sec-13.4.2 is a redacted sub-provision within the likely dispute-resolution cluster. Confirm law is New York/Delaware/California/England and that disputes go to courts rather than foreign arbitration.

Assignment/change-of-control provision is almost certainly in Article 13; sec-13.2.2 ('In the event of [***]') sits in the numbering range typically used for assignment/Acquisition consequences, and 'Acquisition', 'Divestiture' and 'Voting Stock' are defined. Check we may assign to Affiliates and successors and that Harpoon gains no exit on our change of control.

Article 7 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY governs ownership of AbbVie Know-How/AbbVie Patents, Joint IP and AbbVie Reversion IP; verify we retain our own background and generated IP and that nothing assigns our data or improvements to Harpoon. Data/Regulatory Documentation ownership may also appear in Article 3.

Article 5 GRANT OF RIGHTS is the licence clause; confirm the licence to AbbVie extends to Affiliates, Sublicensees and Third Party Providers, and is not revocable at Harpoon's discretion outside the Article 12 termination mechanics.

Article 6 PAYMENTS AND RECORDS should contain Harpoon's audit of AbbVie's royalty records (the 'Audit Expert' definition supports this); check frequency, notice, confidentiality and that Harpoon bears cost absent a material underpayment.

No liquidated damages/penalty concept in the headings; check Article 6 (late payment interest, milestone acceleration) and Article 12 for any termination fee payable by us that functions as a penalty.

Article 10 holds Harpoon's representations and warranties (sec-10.3 covenants of Harpoon); assess IP title/non-infringement, In-License compliance and GxP/performance-style warranties and whether any disclaimer strips them. Our own reps sit in sec-10.4.

Insurance covenants in this deal type are typically a sub-section of Article 11 alongside indemnity; if not there, check Article 13 miscellaneous. Mark missing only if neither article addresses coverage.

No take-or-pay or minimum volume construct expected; obligations on us are milestones (sec-6.2.4, sec-6.3.1) and diligence/Commercially Reasonable Efforts in Articles 3-4, which are separate commercial terms and should not be double-flagged under this rule.

Effects-of-termination provisions in Article 12 should address reversion (Harpoon Reversion Products, AbbVie Reversion IP, Terminated Territory), transfer of Regulatory Documentation and data, and wind-down assistance; cross-check Article 7 for the IP side of any reversion licence.
